  <file path="src/lib/verified-webhook.ts">
    export interface VerifiedWebhookOptions {
      header: string;
      secretEnv: string;
      format: "raw" | "sha256=";
    }
    export function createRawBodyCaptureHook(): preParsingAsyncHookHandler {
      return async (request, _reply, payload) => {
        const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
        for await (const chunk of payload) {
          chunks.push(typeof chunk === "string" ? Buffer.from(chunk) : (chunk as Buffer));
        }
        const rawBody = Buffer.concat(chunks);
        (request as unknown as Record<string | symbol, unknown>)[kRawBody] = rawBody;
        return Readable.from(rawBody);
      };
    }
    export function createVerifiedBodyPreHandler(
      opts: VerifiedWebhookOptions
    ): preHandlerAsyncHookHandler {
      return async (request, reply) => {
        const secret = process.env[opts.secretEnv];
        if (!secret) {
          request.log.warn(`${opts.secretEnv} not configured — rejecting webhook`);
          return reply
            .code(401)
            .send(createProblemDetails(401, "Unauthorized", "Webhook secret not configured"));
        }
    
        const signature = request.headers[opts.header] as string | undefined;
        if (!signature) {
          return reply
            .code(401)
            .send(createProblemDetails(401, "Unauthorized", "Missing webhook signature"));
        }
    
        const rawBody = (request as unknown as Record<string | symbol, unknown>)[kRawBody] as
          Buffer | undefined;
        if (!rawBody) {
          return reply.code(401).send(createProblemDetails(401, "Unauthorized", "Missing raw body"));
        }
    
        const expected =
          opts.format === "sha256="
            ? `sha256=${createHmac("sha256", secret).update(rawBody).digest("hex")}`
            : createHmac("sha256", secret).update(rawBody).digest("hex");
    
        if (expected.length !== signature.length) {
          return reply
            .code(401)
            .send(createProblemDetails(401, "Unauthorized", "Invalid webhook signature"));
        }
    
        if (!timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(expected), Buffer.from(signature))) {
          return reply
            .code(401)
            .send(createProblemDetails(401, "Unauthorized", "Invalid webhook signature"));
        }
    
        request.verifiedBody = rawBody;
      };
    }

  <section priority="medium" role="routes">
  <file path="src/routes/gen-agent-availability-tools.ts">
    type TonightChangeType = (typeof TONIGHT_CHANGE_TYPES)[number];
    type ChangeField = "closeAt" | "from" | "to" | "service" | "tables" | "covers";
    type ChangeTonightInput = z.infer<typeof ChangeTonightInputSchema>;
    type TonightRule = Extract<DateRule, { kind: "tonight" }>;
    function clockToMinute(clock: string): number {
      const [hours, minutes] = clock.split(":").map(Number);
      return hours! * 60 + minutes!;
    }
    function serviceDayMinute(clock: string, config: AvailabilityConfig): number {
      const minute = clockToMinute(clock);
      const opens = config.scheduleServices.map((s) => s.opensAt);
      const earliest = opens.length ? Math.min(...opens) : 0;
      return minute < earliest ? minute + MINUTES_IN_DAY : minute;
    }
    function minuteToClock(minute: number): string {
      const wall = minute % MINUTES_IN_DAY;
      const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
      return `${pad(Math.floor(wall / 60))}:${pad(wall % 60)}`;
    }
    function activeTonightRules(config: AvailabilityConfig, today: string, now: Date): TonightRule[] {
      return config.dateRules.filter(
        (rule): rule is TonightRule =>
          rule.kind === "tonight" &&
          (rule.expiresAt ? Date.parse(rule.expiresAt) > now.getTime() : rule.startsOn === today)
      );
    }
    function changeTypeOf(rule: TonightRule): TonightChangeType {
      const { payload } = rule;
      if ("closeAt" in payload) return "close_early";
      if ("pacing" in payload) return "pacing";
      if (rule.targetKind === "booking") return "pause_online";
      if (rule.targetKind === "tables") return "block_tables";
      return "stop_window";
    }
    function stopTimes(stop: { from: number; to: number }) {
      return stop.from === 0 && stop.to === MINUTES_IN_TWO_DAYS
        ? {}
        : { from: minuteToClock(stop.from), to: minuteToClock(stop.to) };
    }
    function describeRule(
      rule: TonightRule,
      serviceName: (id: string) => string | undefined,
      tableName: (id: string) => string
    ) {
      const change = changeTypeOf(rule);
      const { payload } = rule;
      if ("closeAt" in payload) {
        const service = rule.venueServiceId ? serviceName(rule.venueServiceId) : undefined;
        return { change, closeAt: minuteToClock(payload.closeAt), ...(service ? { service } : {}) };
      }
      if ("pacing" in payload) return { change, covers: payload.pacing.covers };
      if (change === "pause_online") return { change };
      if (change === "block_tables") {
        return { change, tables: (rule.tableIds ?? []).map(tableName), ...stopTimes(payload.stop) };
      }
      return { change, ...stopTimes(payload.stop) };
    }
    function resolveService(
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      name: string
    ): { id: string } | { error: string } {
      const live = config.venueServices.filter((s) => !s.archivedAt);
      const steps: ReadonlyArray<(s: (typeof live)[number]) => boolean> = [
        (s) => s.name === name.trim(),
        (s) => s.name.toLowerCase() === name.trim().toLowerCase(),
      ];
      for (const matches of steps) {
        const found = live.filter(matches);
        if (found.length === 1) return { id: found[0]!.id };
        if (found.length > 1) return { error: `More than one service is called ${name}. Ask which.` };
      }
      return {
        error: `This venue has no service called ${name}. Its services are ${live.map((s) => s.name).join(", ")}.`,
      };
    }
    async function resolveTableIds(
      api: ApiClient,
      venueId: string,
      refs: readonly string[]
    ): Promise<{ ids: string[] } | { error: string }> {
      const { data } = await api.tables.list({ venueId, limit: TABLES_LIMIT });
      const ids: string[] = [];
      for (const ref of refs) {
        const resolved = resolveTable(data, ref);
        if ("error" in resolved) return resolved;
        ids.push(resolved.table.id);
      }
      return { ids };
    }
    async function buildChange(
      input: ChangeTonightInput,
      config: AvailabilityConfig,
      api: ApiClient,
      venueId: string
    ): Promise<{ change: TonightChange } | { error: string }> {
      const minute = (clock: string) => serviceDayMinute(clock, config);
      const window =
        input.from && input.to ? { from: minute(input.from), to: minute(input.to) } : undefined;
      if (window && window.to <= window.from) {
        return { error: `The window must end after it starts (${input.from} to ${input.to}).` };
      }
      switch (input.change) {
        case "pause_online":
          return { change: { type: "pause_online" } };
        case "pacing":
          return { change: { type: "pacing", covers: input.covers! } };
        case "stop_window":
          return { change: { type: "stop_window", ...window! } };
        case "close_early": {
          if (!input.service)
            return { change: { type: "close_early", closeAt: minute(input.closeAt!) } };
          const service = resolveService(config, input.service);
          if ("error" in service) return service;
          return {
            change: {
              type: "close_early",
              closeAt: minute(input.closeAt!),
              venueServiceId: service.id,
            },
          };
        }
        case "block_tables": {
          const tables = await resolveTableIds(api, venueId, input.tables!);
          if ("error" in tables) return tables;
          return {
            change: {
              type: "block_tables",
              tableIds: tables.ids,
              ...(input.from ? { from: minute(input.from) } : {}),
              ...(input.to ? { to: minute(input.to) } : {}),
            },
          };
        }
      }
    }
    function availabilityWriteFailure(err: unknown, action: string) {
      const refusal = refusalOf(err);
      if (!refusal)
        return { error: `Couldn't ${action} right now. Ask the user to try again shortly.` };
      const base = { refused: true, ...(refusal.code ? { code: refusal.code } : {}) };
      switch (refusal.code ?? (refusal.status === 403 ? "forbidden" : undefined)) {
        case "decision-required":
          return {
            ...base,
            needsDecisions: true,
            error: `This affects existing bookings, and each one needs a decision (cancel, move or keep). ${AVAILABILITY_PAGE} Nothing was changed.`,
          };
        case "version-conflict":
          return {
            ...base,
            error:
              "Availability changed since it was read, so nothing was saved. Check the current Tonight changes and ask the user to confirm again.",
          };
        case "guests-notified":
          return {
            ...base,
            error: "That change already told guests, so it can't be undone. Nothing was changed.",
          };
        case "forbidden":
          return {
            ...base,
            error:
              "The user doesn't have permission to make this change. A manager can make it, or it can be done on the Availability page.",
          };
        default:
          return { ...base, error: `${refusal.detail} Nothing was changed.` };
      }
    }
    export function createAvailabilityTools(
      log: FastifyBaseLogger,
      api: ApiClient,
      {
        venueId,
        timeZone,
      }: { readonly venueId?: string | undefined; readonly timeZone?: string | undefined }
    ): ToolSet {
      /** The Tonight rules in force, with the config they came from. */
      async function readTonight() {
        const state = await api.availability.getConfig(venueId!);
        const rules = activeTonightRules(state.config, todayIn(timeZone), new Date());
        return { state, rules };
      }
    
      return {
        // ── Read ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        list_tonight_changes: tool({
          description:
            "List the Tonight changes in force (paused online booking, close early, stopped windows, blocked tables, pacing), and the newest availability change that can still be undone. Call it before ending or undoing a change.",
          inputSchema: z.object({}),
          execute: async () => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId }, "list_tonight_changes tool called");
            try {
              const { state, rules } = await readTonight();
              const needsTables = rules.some((r) => r.tableIds?.length);
              const tables = needsTables
                ? (await api.tables.list({ venueId, limit: TABLES_LIMIT })).data
                : [];
              const serviceName = (id: string) =>
                state.config.venueServices.find((s) => s.id === id)?.name;
              const tableName = (id: string) => {
                const table = tables.find((t) => t.id === id);
                return table?.name ?? table?.tableNumber ?? id;
              };
              const page = await api.availability.listChanges(venueId, { limit: 1 });
              const newest = page.items[0];
              return {
                changes: rules.map((rule) => describeRule(rule, serviceName, tableName)),
                undoable: newest?.revertible ? { summary: newest.summary, at: newest.at } : null,
              };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "list_tonight_changes failed");
              return { error: "Couldn't read tonight's availability. Ask the user to try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        // ── Write (each runs only after the user confirms) ─────
        change_tonight_availability: tool({
          description:
            "Make one Tonight change for the venue's current service day; it ends on its own when the day does. Requires confirmation. For a closure, special hours or a schedule change on another day, point the user to the Availability page instead.",
          inputSchema: ChangeTonightInputSchema,
          execute: async (input) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, change: input.change }, "change_tonight_availability tool called");
            try {
              const state = await api.availability.getConfig(venueId);
              const built = await buildChange(input, state.config, api, venueId);
              if ("error" in built) return built;
              const result = await api.availability.setTonight(venueId, {
                expectedVersion: state.version,
                ruleId: randomUUID(),
                change: built.change,
              });
              const until = localTimeIn(result.expiresAt, timeZone);
              return {
                applied: true,
                serviceDate: result.serviceDate,
                ...(until ? { until } : {}),
              };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, change: input.change }, "change_tonight_availability failed");
              return availabilityWriteFailure(err, "make the change");
            }
          },
        }),
    
        end_tonight_change: tool({
          description:
            "End a Tonight change early so its times or tables open again. Bookings a close-early cancelled stay cancelled. Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            change: z.enum(TONIGHT_CHANGE_TYPES).describe("The kind of Tonight change to end"),
            from: ClockSchema.optional().describe(
              "When several stop windows or table blocks are in force: the start of the one to end, HH:MM"
            ),
          }),
          execute: async ({ change, from }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, change }, "end_tonight_change tool called");
            try {
              const { rules } = await readTonight();
              const ofKind = rules.filter((rule) => changeTypeOf(rule) === change);
              const matches = from
                ? ofKind.filter(
                    (rule) => "stop" in rule.payload && minuteToClock(rule.payload.stop.from) === from
                  )
                : ofKind;
              if (matches.length === 0) {
                return { error: `No ${change.replace(/_/g, " ")} change is in force tonight.` };
              }
              if (matches.length > 1) {
                return {
                  error: `More than one ${change.replace(/_/g, " ")} change is in force. Ask which one, by its start time.`,
                };
              }
              await api.availability.endTonight(venueId, matches[0]!.id);
              return { ended: true, change };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, change }, "end_tonight_change failed");
              return availabilityWriteFailure(err, "end the change");
            }
          },
        }),
    
        undo_availability_change: tool({
          description:
            "Undo the newest availability change, when list_tonight_changes offers it as undoable. Pass its summary exactly as listed. A change that told guests can't be undone. Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            summary: z.string().min(1).describe("The undoable change's summary, copied exactly"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ summary }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId }, "undo_availability_change tool called");
            try {
              const page = await api.availability.listChanges(venueId, { limit: 1 });
              const newest = page.items[0];
              if (!newest?.revertible) {
                return {
                  error: "No availability change can be undone right now. Nothing was changed.",
                };
              }
              // The user confirmed this summary: undo only that change, never whatever is newest now.
              if (newest.summary !== summary) {
                return {
                  error: `The newest change is now "${newest.summary}", not the one confirmed. Nothing was changed; ask the user again.`,
                };
              }
              const { version } = await api.availability.getConfig(venueId);
              await api.availability.revertChange(venueId, newest.id, version);
              return { undone: true, summary };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "undo_availability_change failed");
              return availabilityWriteFailure(err, "undo the change");
            }
          },
        }),
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/routes/gen-agent-prompt.ts">
    export const CHAT_PAGES = {
      timeline: "Timeline page (the day's bookings on the floor, table by table)",
      dashboard: "Dashboard page (today's covers, waitlist and lapsing guests)",
      reservations: "Reservations page (the booking list)",
      guests: "Guests page (the guest directory)",
      waitlist: "Waitlist page (walk-ins waiting for a table)",
      briefing: "Briefing page (the pre-shift briefing)",
      "floor-plans": "Floor plans page (the venue's layouts and tables)",
      availability: "Availability page (schedules, closures and Tonight changes)",
      menus: "Menus page (the venue's menus and items)",
      "booking-widget": "Booking widget page (the guest booking widget preview)",
      settings: "Settings page (preferences, venue profile and team)",
    } as const;
    export type ChatPage = keyof typeof CHAT_PAGES;
    export const CHAT_PAGE_NAMES = Object.keys(CHAT_PAGES) as [ChatPage, ...ChatPage[]];
    export const CHAT_FOCUS_KINDS = ["reservation", "floorPlan", "menu"] as const;
    export interface ChatFocus {
      readonly kind: (typeof CHAT_FOCUS_KINDS)[number];
      readonly id: string;
    }
    function pageLines(ctx: AgentPromptContext): string[] {
      if (!ctx.page) return [];
      const lines = [`The user has the chat open on the ${CHAT_PAGES[ctx.page]}.`];
      if (ctx.focus) {
        const noun = FOCUS_WORDS[ctx.focus.kind];
        lines.push(
          `They have ${noun} ${ctx.focus.id} open: read "this ${noun}" or "this one" as it, and use that id with the tools.`
        );
      }
      if (ctx.focusDate) {
        lines.push(`The page shows ${ctx.focusDate}: read "this day" or "that day" as it.`);
      }
      return lines;
    }
    export interface AgentPromptContext {
      /** The venue selected in the app, when there is one. */
      readonly venueId?: string | undefined;
      /** The dashboard page the chat was opened on. */
      readonly page?: ChatPage | undefined;
      /** The record that page has open. */
      readonly focus?: ChatFocus | undefined;
      /** The YYYY-MM-DD date that page shows. */
      readonly focusDate?: string | undefined;
      /** The venue's IANA time zone; UTC when absent. */
      readonly timeZone?: string | undefined;
      readonly now: Date;
      /** The rialto component reference (see chatComponentReference), appended verbatim. */
      readonly catalogPrompt: string;
    }
    export function chatComponentReference(catalogPrompt: string): string {
      const start = catalogPrompt.indexOf(COMPONENTS_START);
      const end = catalogPrompt.indexOf(COMPONENTS_END, start);
      if (start === -1 || end === -1) {
        throw new Error(
          `catalog prompt layout changed: expected "${COMPONENTS_START}" followed by "AVAILABLE ACTIONS:"`
        );
      }
      return catalogPrompt.slice(start, end);
    }
    function weekdayIn(timeZone: string, now: Date): string {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone, weekday: "long" }).format(now);
    }
    export function buildAgentSystemPrompt(ctx: AgentPromptContext): string {
      const timeZone = ctx.timeZone ?? "UTC";
      const today = `${weekdayIn(timeZone, ctx.now)}, ${todayIn(timeZone, ctx.now)}`;
      const venueLine = ctx.venueId
        ? "The user's venue is already selected, and every tool is scoped to it automatically."
        : "No venue is selected yet. If a request needs venue data, ask the user to pick a venue in the app.";
    
      return [
        "You are the assistant for a restaurant's front-of-house staff, inside their hospitality dashboard.",
        `Today is ${today} (${timeZone}). Resolve "tonight", "tomorrow", and weekday names against this date, and pass dates to tools as YYYY-MM-DD.`,
        venueLine,
        ...pageLines(ctx),
        "Never ask the user for a venue ID, reservation ID, or table ID: look them up with the tools.",
        "Your earlier replies in this conversation were based on tool results that aren't shown to you again. Treat them as accurate: don't apologize for or correct them unless a new tool result actually contradicts them. When you need an earlier detail, such as an ID, look it up again.",
        "A change (booking, seating, no-show, walk-in, cancellation, table status, Tonight availability, waitlist) runs only when the user presses the Confirm or Cancel button the chat shows with it. Tell them to use those buttons, and never ask them to type yes: typing a new message dismisses the pending change.",
        "Ask only for details the user has to decide, such as guest name, party size, or time. When a reservation's end time isn't given, use two hours after the start.",

Never write JSON, element specs or patch lines in your reply text.",

  <file path="src/routes/gen-agent-timeline-tools.ts">
    type Reservation = Awaited<ReturnType<ApiClient["reservations"]["get"]>>;
    function bookingWriteFailure(err: unknown, action: string, saved?: string) {
      const outcome = saved
        ? `${saved} was already saved; check the timeline before trying again.`
        : "Nothing was changed.";
      const refusal = refusalOf(err);
      if (!refusal) {
        return { error: `Couldn't ${action} right now. ${outcome} Ask the user to try again shortly.` };
      }
      if (refusal.status === 403) {
        return { refused: true, error: `The user doesn't have permission to do this. ${outcome}` };
      }
      return { refused: true, error: `${refusal.detail} ${outcome}` };
    }
    async function venueReservation(
      api: ApiClient,
      venueId: string,
      reservationId: string
    ): Promise<{ reservation: Reservation } | { error: string }> {
      const reservation = await api.reservations.get(reservationId);
      if (reservation.venueId !== venueId) {
        return { error: "That reservation isn't at this venue. Look it up again." };
      }
      return { reservation };
    }
    export function createTimelineTools(
      log: FastifyBaseLogger,
      api: ApiClient,
      { venueId }: { readonly venueId?: string | undefined }
    ): ToolSet {
      return {
        seat_reservation: tool({
          description:
            "Seat a booked party that has arrived: at its booked table, or at the table staff name. Marks the table occupied, as the timeline's Seat button does. For a walk-in with no booking, use seat_walk_in. Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            reservationId: ReservationIdSchema,
            table: z
              .string()
              .min(1)
              .optional()
              .describe("Seat at this table instead, by its name or number; omit for the booked table"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ reservationId, table: tableRef }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, reservationId, tableRef }, "seat_reservation tool called");
            let saved: string | undefined;
            try {
              const found = await venueReservation(api, venueId, reservationId);
              if ("error" in found) return found;
              const { reservation } = found;
              if (!SEATABLE_STATUSES.has(reservation.status)) {
                return {
                  error: `This booking is ${reservation.status.toLowerCase().replace(/_/g, " ")}, so it can't be seated.`,
                };
              }
              const { data: tables } = await api.tables.list({ venueId, limit: TABLES_LIMIT });
              const chosen = tableRef ? resolveTable(tables, tableRef) : undefined;
              if (chosen && "error" in chosen) return chosen;
              const tableId = chosen?.table.id ?? reservation.tableId;
              if (!tableId) {
                return { error: "This booking has no table. Ask which table to seat them at." };
              }
              const target = tables.find((t) => t.id === tableId);
              const tableLabel = target?.name ?? target?.tableNumber ?? tableId;
              // Only an AVAILABLE table can be seated: check before writing anything.
              if (target && target.status !== "AVAILABLE") {
                return {
                  error: `Table ${tableLabel} is ${target.status.toLowerCase()}, so the party can't be seated there. Nothing was changed.`,
                };
              }
              // The server has no CONFIRMED -> CONFIRMED edge, so only a pending booking changes
              // status; and it refuses a status change combined with a table change, so they go
              // as separate requests.
              if (reservation.status === "PENDING") {
                await api.reservations.update(reservationId, { status: "CONFIRMED" });
                saved = "Confirming the booking";
              }
              if (tableId !== reservation.tableId) {
                await api.reservations.update(reservationId, { tableId });
                saved = saved
                  ? `${saved} and moving it to ${tableLabel}`
                  : `Moving it to ${tableLabel}`;
              }
              await api.tables.updateStatus(tableId, "OCCUPIED");
              return { seated: true, table: tableLabel };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, reservationId }, "seat_reservation failed");
              return bookingWriteFailure(err, "seat the party", saved);
            }
          },
        }),
    
        mark_no_show: tool({
          description: "Mark a booking as a no-show: the party never arrived. Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({ reservationId: ReservationIdSchema }),
          execute: async ({ reservationId }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, reservationId }, "mark_no_show tool called");
            try {
              const found = await venueReservation(api, venueId, reservationId);
              if ("error" in found) return found;
              const { warning } = await api.reservations.markNoShow(reservationId);
              return { noShow: true, ...(warning ? { warning } : {}) };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, reservationId }, "mark_no_show failed");
              return bookingWriteFailure(err, "mark the no-show");
            }
          },
        }),
    
        cancel_reservation: tool({
          description:
            "Cancel a reservation, with the reason and a note when the user gives them. Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            reservationId: z.string().optional().describe("Reservation ID to cancel"),
            guestName: z.string().optional().describe("Guest name to look up and cancel"),
            date: z.string().optional().describe("Date to narrow search"),
            reason: z
              .enum(CANCEL_REASONS)
              .optional()
              .describe("Why it is cancelled, when the user says"),
            note: z.string().max(500).optional().describe("A note on the cancellation"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ reservationId, reason, note }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ reservationId, reason }, "cancel_reservation tool called");
            try {
              if (!reservationId) {
                return {
                  error: "Reservation ID is required to cancel. Please look up the reservation first.",
                };
              }
              const reservation =
                reason || note
                  ? await api.reservations.cancelWithReason(reservationId, {
                      ...(reason ? { cancellationReason: reason } : {}),
                      ...(note ? { cancellationNote: note } : {}),
                    })
                  : await api.reservations.cancel(reservationId);
              return { reservation };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, reservationId }, "cancel_reservation failed");
              return { error: "Failed to cancel reservation. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/routes/gen-agent-tools.ts">
    export interface ConfirmedAction {
      /** Echo of the action_request's actionId — traceability only (a resend produces new tool-call ids). */
      readonly actionId: string;
      readonly toolName: string;
      readonly toolInput: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
    export interface CreateAgentToolsOptions {
      readonly confirmedAction?: ConfirmedAction | undefined;
      /** The venue the user has selected in the app; every venue-scoped tool is pinned to it. */
      readonly venueId?: string | undefined;
      /** The venue's IANA time zone, so "today" means the venue's today rather than UTC's. */
      readonly timeZone?: string | undefined;
    }
    function withLocalTime<T extends object>(
      item: T,
      field: string,
      timeZone: string | undefined
    ): T | (T & { localTime: string }) {
      const localTime = localTimeIn((item as Record<string, unknown>)[field], timeZone);
      return localTime ? { ...item, localTime } : item;
    }
    type PublicAvailability = Awaited<ReturnType<ApiClient["availability"]["getPublicAvailability"]>>;
    function rejectedResult(refusal: Refusal) {
      return { rejected: true, error: refusal.detail } as const;
    }
    export function localToInstant(
      date: string,
      time: string,
      timeZone: string | undefined
    ): string | undefined {
      const match = /^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/.exec(date);
      const clock = /^(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})$/.exec(time);
      if (!match || !clock) return undefined;
      const year = Number(match[1]);
      const month = Number(match[2]);
      const day = Number(match[3]);
      const hour = Number(clock[1]);
      const minute = Number(clock[2]);
      const wall = Date.UTC(year, month - 1, day, hour, minute);
      // Date.UTC rolls 2026-02-30 to March 2: reject anything that doesn't read back as given.
      const readBack = new Date(wall);
      if (
        readBack.getUTCFullYear() !== year ||
        readBack.getUTCMonth() !== month - 1 ||
        readBack.getUTCDate() !== day ||
        hour > 23 ||
        minute > 59
      ) {
        return undefined;
      }
      try {
        const offsetAt = (instant: number): number => {
          const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", {
            timeZone: timeZone ?? "UTC",
            hourCycle: "h23",
            year: "numeric",
            month: "2-digit",
            day: "2-digit",
            hour: "2-digit",
            minute: "2-digit",
          }).formatToParts(new Date(instant));
          const get = (type: string) => Number(parts.find((p) => p.type === type)?.value);
          const shown = Date.UTC(get("year"), get("month") - 1, get("day"), get("hour"), get("minute"));
          return shown - Math.floor(instant / 60000) * 60000;
        };
        const first = wall - offsetAt(wall);
        return new Date(wall - offsetAt(first)).toISOString();
      } catch {
        return undefined; // unknown time zone (RangeError)
      }
    }
    function nextDay(date: string): string | undefined {
      const instant = localToInstant(date, "12:00", undefined);
      return instant
        ? new Date(Date.parse(instant) + 86_400_000).toISOString().slice(0, 10)
        : undefined;
    }
    function reservationWindow(
      date: string,
      startTime: string,
      endTime: string,
      timeZone: string | undefined
    ): { start: string; end: string } | undefined {
      const start = localToInstant(date, startTime, timeZone);
      const sameDayEnd = localToInstant(date, endTime, timeZone);
      if (!start || !sameDayEnd) return undefined;
      if (sameDayEnd > start) return { start, end: sameDayEnd };
      const following = nextDay(date);
      const end = following ? localToInstant(following, endTime, timeZone) : undefined;
      return end ? { start, end } : undefined;
    }
    function createFailureResult(err: unknown) {
      const refusal = refusalOf(err);
      if (!refusal) return { error: "Failed to create reservation. Please try again." };
      if (!FINAL_REFUSAL_STATUSES.has(refusal.status)) {
        // e.g. a 400 from our own malformed request: not the venue's decision.
        return { error: `Failed to create reservation: ${refusal.detail}` };
      }
      return {
        refused: true,
        error: refusal.detail,
        ...(refusal.code ? { code: refusal.code } : {}),
        ...(refusal.reason ? { reason: refusal.reason } : {}),
        note: "The venue refused this booking and nothing was created. Tell the user the reason; do not retry the same booking.",
      };
    }
    type BookingVerdict = Awaited<ReturnType<ApiClient["availability"]["checkBooking"]>>;
    function bookingVerdictResult(
      verdict: BookingVerdict,
      judged: { readonly date: string; readonly startTime: string }
    ) {
      if (verdict.kind === "ok") return { bookable: true, judged } as const;
      if (verdict.kind === "soft") {
        return {
          bookable: false,
          softLimit: true,
          message: verdict.message,
          judged,
          note: "This time needs a staff override of a venue limit. You cannot override it: tell the user the limit and that staff can book it from the reservation form.",
        } as const;
      }
      return { bookable: false, reason: verdict.reason, message: verdict.message, judged } as const;
    }
    function availabilityResult(
      response: PublicAvailability,
      date: string,
      timeZone: string | undefined
    ) {
      const slots = response.data.map((slot) => withLocalTime(slot, "time", timeZone));
      const { closure, bookingPaused } = response;
      return {
        slots,
        ...(slots.length === 0 && !closure && !bookingPaused
          ? {
              note: "This online list is empty, but that is not the staff verdict: a service that takes phone bookings only shows no online slots. Do not say the day is full. Ask the user which time they want and check it with check_booking_time.",
            }
          : {}),
        ...(closure
          ? {
              closed: true,
              closureMessage: closure.message,
              note: `The venue is closed on ${date} (${closure.message}), so nothing can be booked. Say so rather than calling the day fully booked.`,
            }
          : {}),
        ...(bookingPaused
          ? {
              bookingPaused,
              note: `Online booking is paused: ${bookingPaused.message}${bookingPaused.phone ? ` Guests can call ${bookingPaused.phone}.` : ""} Say so rather than calling the day fully booked.`,
            }
          : {}),
      };
    }
    function gateWriteTools(
      tools: ToolSet,
      log: FastifyBaseLogger,
      confirmedAction?: ConfirmedAction
    ): ToolSet {
      let consumed = false;
      const gated: ToolSet = { ...tools };
      for (const name of GEN_WRITE_TOOL_NAMES) {
        const original = gated[name];
        const originalExecute = original?.execute;
        if (!original || !originalExecute) continue;
        gated[name] = {
          ...original,
          execute: async (_input: never, ctx: never) => {
            if (confirmedAction?.toolName !== name) {
              log.info({ toolName: name }, "write tool call held for user confirmation");
              return CONFIRMATION_PENDING;
            }
            if (consumed) {
              return { error: "This confirmed action has already been executed." };
            }
            const schema = original.inputSchema as z.ZodType;
            const parsed = schema.safeParse(confirmedAction.toolInput);
            if (!parsed.success) {
              log.error(
                { toolName: name, actionId: confirmedAction.actionId },
                "confirmed action input invalid, refusing to execute"
              );
              return { error: "The confirmed action's parameters are invalid. Please start over." };
            }
            consumed = true;
            log.info(
              { toolName: name, actionId: confirmedAction.actionId },
              "executing user-confirmed action"
            );
            return originalExecute(parsed.data as never, ctx);
          },
        } as ToolSet[string];
      }
      return gated;
    }
    export function createAgentTools(
      log: FastifyBaseLogger,
      api: ApiClient,
      options: CreateAgentToolsOptions = {}
    ): ToolSet {
      const { venueId, timeZone } = options;
      const toLocal = <T extends object>(reservation: T) =>
        withLocalTime(reservation, "startTime", timeZone);
      const tools: ToolSet = {
        // ── Read tools (instant, no confirmation) ──────────────
        // venueId never comes from the model: it is the app's selected venue.
        check_availability: tool({
          description:
            "List the time slots open to ONLINE guests on a date. This is the online booking widget's view only: a service that takes phone bookings only shows no slots here. Before telling staff a time can or cannot be booked, confirm it with check_booking_time, the same check create_reservation is judged by.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            date: z.string().describe("Date in YYYY-MM-DD format"),
            partySize: z.number().describe("Number of guests"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ date, partySize }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, date, partySize }, "check_availability tool called");
            try {
              // The public endpoint is slug-scoped and already carries closures and pauses.
              const { slug } = await api.venues.get(venueId);
              const response = await api.availability.getPublicAvailability(slug, { date, partySize });
              return availabilityResult(response, date, timeZone);
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, date, partySize }, "check_availability failed");
              const refusal = refusalOf(err);
              if (refusal) return rejectedResult(refusal);
              // Timeout, 5xx or network failure: unknown, never "closed".
              return AVAILABILITY_UNKNOWN;
            }
          },
        }),
    
        check_booking_time: tool({
          description:
            "Check whether staff can book a specific start time, judged on the phone channel exactly as create_reservation will judge it (closures, service hours, party-size and pacing limits, table conflicts).",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            date: z.string().describe("Date in YYYY-MM-DD format"),
            startTime: z.string().describe("Start time in HH:MM format, venue-local"),
            partySize: z.number().describe("Number of guests"),
            tableId: z.string().optional().describe("Table ID to check; omit to ask if any is free"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ date, startTime, partySize, tableId }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, date, startTime, partySize }, "check_booking_time tool called");
            const start = localToInstant(date, startTime, timeZone);
            if (!start) {
              return { rejected: true, error: UNREADABLE_TIME };
            }
            try {
              const verdict = await api.availability.checkBooking(venueId, {
                start,
                partySize,
                channel: "phone",
                ...(tableId ? { tableId } : {}),
              });
              return bookingVerdictResult(verdict, { date, startTime });
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, date, startTime, partySize }, "check_booking_time failed");
              const refusal = refusalOf(err);
              return refusal ? rejectedResult(refusal) : AVAILABILITY_UNKNOWN;
            }
          },
        }),
    
        lookup_reservation: tool({
          description: "Find reservations by guest name and/or date",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            guestName: z.string().optional().describe("Guest name (or part of it) to search"),
            date: z.string().optional().describe("Date in YYYY-MM-DD format"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ guestName, date }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ date, venueId }, "lookup_reservation tool called");
            const dateFilter = date ? { date } : {};
            try {
              const venueList = await api.reservations.list({
                venueId,
                ...dateFilter,
                limit: LOOKUP_LIMIT,
              });
              const needle = guestName?.trim().toLowerCase();
              if (!needle) return { reservations: venueList.data.map(toLocal) };
              // The list is paginated, so a name filter over it alone misses most
              // of a busy venue: resolve the guest first, then list their bookings.
              const guests = await api.guests.search({ venueId, query: guestName! });
              const byGuest = await Promise.all(
                guests.data.slice(0, MAX_GUEST_MATCHES).map((guest) =>
                  api.reservations.list({
                    venueId,
                    guestId: guest.id,
                    ...dateFilter,
                    limit: LOOKUP_LIMIT,
                  })
                )
              );
              // Walk-ins can carry a name with no guest profile; match those by name.
              const byName = venueList.data.filter((r) => r.guestName?.toLowerCase().includes(needle));
              const merged = [...byGuest.flatMap((page) => page.data), ...byName];
              const reservations = merged.filter(
                (r, i) => merged.findIndex((other) => other.id === r.id) === i
              );
              return { reservations: reservations.map(toLocal) };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, date, venueId }, "lookup_reservation failed");
              return { error: "Failed to look up reservations. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        search_guests: tool({
          description: "Search guest directory by name, email, or phone",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            query: z.string().describe("Search term (name, email, or phone)"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ query }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ query, venueId }, "search_guests tool called");
            try {
              const result = await api.guests.search({ venueId, query });
              return { guests: result.data };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, query, venueId }, "search_guests failed");
              return { error: "Failed to search guests. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        get_table_status: tool({
          description: "Check the status of a specific table or all tables",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            tableNumber: z.number().optional().describe("Specific table number to check"),
          }),
          execute: async () => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId }, "get_table_status tool called");
            try {
              const result = await api.tables.list({ venueId });
              return { tables: result.data };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "get_table_status failed");
              return { error: "Failed to get table status. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        list_today_reservations: tool({
          description: "List all reservations for today or a specified date",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            date: z.string().optional().describe("Date in YYYY-MM-DD format, defaults to today"),
            status: z
              .enum(["PENDING", "CONFIRMED", "CANCELLED", "COMPLETED", "NO_SHOW"])
              .optional()
              .describe("Filter by reservation status"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ date, status }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, date, status }, "list_today_reservations tool called");
            try {
              const queryDate = date ?? todayIn(timeZone);
              const result = await api.reservations.list({
                venueId,
                date: queryDate,
                limit: 50,
                ...(status ? { status } : {}),
              });
              return { reservations: result.data.map(toLocal) };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, date }, "list_today_reservations failed");
              return { error: "Failed to list reservations. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        // ── Render tool (special handling — emits elements) ────
        render_component: tool({
          description:
            "Render interactive UI components in the chat. Use when visual presentation is better than text — availability cards, reservation summaries, confirmation forms. Elements use the rialto component catalog.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            elements: z.array(
              z.object({
                id: z.string(),
                type: z.string(),
                props: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
                children: z.array(z.string()).optional(),
              })
            ),
          }),
          execute: async () => ({ rendered: true }),
        }),
    
        // ── Write tools (require confirmation) ─────────────────
        create_reservation: tool({
          description: "Create a new reservation. Requires confirmation before executing.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            guestName: z.string().describe("Guest name"),
            date: z.string().describe("Date in YYYY-MM-DD format"),
            startTime: z.string().describe("Start time in HH:MM format"),
            endTime: z.string().describe("End time in HH:MM format"),
            partySize: z.number().describe("Number of guests"),
            tableId: z.string().describe("Table ID to reserve"),
            notes: z.string().optional().describe("Reservation notes"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ guestName, date, startTime, endTime, partySize, tableId, notes }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ guestName, date, startTime, partySize }, "create_reservation tool called");
            const window = reservationWindow(date, startTime, endTime, timeZone);
            if (!window) return { error: UNREADABLE_TIME };
            try {
              const reservation = await api.reservations.create({
                guestName,
                date,
                startTime: window.start,
                endTime: window.end,
                partySize,
                tableId,
                venueId,
                ...(notes ? { notes } : {}),
              });
              return { reservation };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, guestName, date }, "create_reservation failed");
              return createFailureResult(err);
            }
          },
        }),
    
        modify_reservation: tool({
          description:
            "Modify an existing reservation (time, table, party size, or notes). Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            reservationId: z.string().describe("Reservation ID to modify"),
            date: z.string().optional().describe("New date in YYYY-MM-DD format"),
            startTime: z.string().optional().describe("New start time in HH:MM format"),
            endTime: z.string().optional().describe("New end time in HH:MM format"),
            partySize: z.number().optional().describe("New party size"),
            tableId: z.string().optional().describe("New table ID"),
            notes: z.string().optional().describe("Updated notes"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ reservationId, ...updates }) => {
            log.info({ reservationId, ...updates }, "modify_reservation tool called");
            try {
              const cleanUpdates = Object.fromEntries(
                Object.entries(updates).filter(([, v]) => v !== undefined)
              );
              const reservation = await api.reservations.update(reservationId, cleanUpdates);
              return { reservation };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, reservationId }, "modify_reservation failed");
              return { error: "Failed to modify reservation. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        seat_walk_in: tool({
          description:
            "Create a walk-in reservation and seat guests immediately. Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            partySize: z.number().describe("Number of guests"),
            tableId: z
              .string()
              .optional()
              .describe("Specific table to seat at (auto-assigns if omitted)"),
            guestName: z.string().optional().describe("Guest name if provided"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ partySize, tableId, guestName }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, partySize, tableId, guestName }, "seat_walk_in tool called");
            try {
              if (!tableId) {
                return {
                  error: "A table must be specified for walk-ins. Check available tables first.",
                };
              }
              const reservation = await api.reservations.walkIn({
                venueId,
                partySize,
                tableId,
                ...(guestName ? { guestName } : {}),
              });
              return { reservation };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, partySize }, "seat_walk_in failed");
              return { error: "Failed to seat walk-in. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        update_table_status: tool({
          description:
            "Update a table's status (clean, dirty, occupied, available). Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            table: z.string().describe("The table's name or number, as staff call it"),
            status: z.enum(["AVAILABLE", "OCCUPIED", "DIRTY", "READY"]).describe("New table status"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ table: tableRef, status: newStatus }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, tableRef, newStatus }, "update_table_status tool called");
            try {
              const tablesResult = await api.tables.list({ venueId });
              const resolved = resolveTable(tablesResult.data, tableRef);
              if ("error" in resolved) return resolved;
              const { table } = resolved;
              const updated = await api.tables.updateStatus(table.id, newStatus);
              return { table: updated };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId, tableRef }, "update_table_status failed");
              return { error: "Failed to update table status. Please try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        ...createAvailabilityTools(log, api, { venueId, timeZone }),
        ...createWaitlistTools(log, api, { venueId, timeZone }),
        ...createTimelineTools(log, api, { venueId }),
      };
      return gateWriteTools(tools, log, options.confirmedAction);
    }

  <file path="src/routes/gen-agent-waitlist-tools.ts">
    type WaitlistEntry = Awaited<ReturnType<ApiClient["waitlist"]["list"]>>[number];
    function waitlistFailure(err: unknown, action: string) {
      const refusal = refusalOf(err);
      if (!refusal) {
        return {
          error: `Couldn't ${action} right now. Nothing was changed. Ask the user to try again.`,
        };
      }
      if (refusal.status === 403) {
        return {
          refused: true,
          error: "The user doesn't have permission to do this. Nothing was changed.",
        };
      }
      return { refused: true, error: `${refusal.detail} Nothing was changed.` };
    }
    async function findParty(
      api: ApiClient,
      venueId: string,
      guestName: string,
      partySize: number | undefined
    ): Promise<{ entry: WaitlistEntry } | { error: string }> {
      const entries = await api.waitlist.list(venueId);
      const name = guestName.trim().toLowerCase();
      const named = entries.filter(
        (e) => ACTIVE_STATUSES.has(e.status) && e.guestName.trim().toLowerCase() === name
      );
      const matches = partySize === undefined ? named : named.filter((e) => e.partySize === partySize);
      if (matches.length === 1) return { entry: matches[0]! };
      if (matches.length === 0) {
        return {
          error: `No party called ${guestName} is waiting${partySize ? ` with ${partySize} guests` : ""}.`,
        };
      }
      const sizes = matches.map((e) => e.partySize).join(" and ");
      return {
        error: `${matches.length} waiting parties are called ${guestName} (party sizes ${sizes}). Ask which one, by party size.`,
      };
    }
    export function createWaitlistTools(
      log: FastifyBaseLogger,
      api: ApiClient,
      {
        venueId,
        timeZone,
      }: { readonly venueId?: string | undefined; readonly timeZone?: string | undefined }
    ): ToolSet {
      return {
        // ── Read ───────────────────────────────────────────────
        list_waitlist: tool({
          description:
            "List the parties on the waitlist now, in order: name, party size, quoted wait, whether they've been told their table is ready, and when they joined.",
          inputSchema: z.object({}),
          execute: async () => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId }, "list_waitlist tool called");
            try {
              const entries = await api.waitlist.list(venueId);
              const parties = entries
                .filter((e) => ACTIVE_STATUSES.has(e.status))
                .sort((a, b) => a.position - b.position)
                .map((e) => {
                  const joinedAt = localTimeIn(e.createdAt, timeZone);
                  return {
                    guestName: e.guestName,
                    partySize: e.partySize,
                    position: e.position,
                    quotedWaitMinutes: e.estimatedWaitMinutes,
                    status: e.status,
                    ...(joinedAt ? { joinedAt } : {}),
                  };
                });
              return { parties };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "list_waitlist failed");
              const refusal = refusalOf(err);
              return refusal?.status === 403
                ? { refused: true, error: "The user doesn't have permission to see the waitlist." }
                : { error: "Couldn't read the waitlist. Ask the user to try again." };
            }
          },
        }),
    
        // ── Write (each runs only after the user confirms) ─────
        add_to_waitlist: tool({
          description:
            "Add a walk-in party to the waitlist. Needs their name, party size and phone number (the waitlist texts them when their table is ready). Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            guestName: z.string().min(1).describe("The party's name"),
            partySize: z.number().int().min(1).describe("Number of guests"),
            guestPhone: z.string().min(1).describe("The guest's phone number"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ guestName, partySize, guestPhone }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, partySize }, "add_to_waitlist tool called");
            try {
              const added = await api.waitlist.create({ venueId, guestName, partySize, guestPhone });
              return {
                added: true,
                position: added.position,
                quotedWaitMinutes: added.estimatedWaitMinutes,
              };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "add_to_waitlist failed");
              return waitlistFailure(err, "add the party");
            }
          },
        }),
    
        notify_waitlist_party: tool({
          description:
            "Tell a waiting party their table is ready (sends them a text). Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object(PartySchema),
          execute: async ({ guestName, partySize }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId }, "notify_waitlist_party tool called");
            try {
              const found = await findParty(api, venueId, guestName, partySize);
              if ("error" in found) return found;
              // The server notifies only a waiting party: a second notify sends nothing but still answers 200.
              if (found.entry.status === "notified") {
                const at = localTimeIn(found.entry.notifiedAt, timeZone);
                return {
                  error: `${found.entry.guestName} was already told their table is ready${at ? ` at ${at}` : ""}. No new text was sent.`,
                };
              }
              await api.waitlist.notify(found.entry.id);
              return { notified: true, guestName: found.entry.guestName };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "notify_waitlist_party failed");
              return waitlistFailure(err, "notify the party");
            }
          },
        }),
    
        seat_waitlist_party: tool({
          description:
            "Seat a waiting party at a table staff name: creates their walk-in at that table and takes them off the waitlist. Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object({
            ...PartySchema,
            table: z.string().min(1).describe("The table's name or number, as staff call it"),
          }),
          execute: async ({ guestName, partySize, table: tableRef }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId, tableRef }, "seat_waitlist_party tool called");
            let seatedAt: string | undefined;
            try {
              const found = await findParty(api, venueId, guestName, partySize);
              if ("error" in found) return found;
              const { entry } = found;
              const { data: tables } = await api.tables.list({ venueId, limit: TABLES_LIMIT });
              const resolved = resolveTable(tables, tableRef);
              if ("error" in resolved) return resolved;
              const { table } = resolved;
              const label = table.name ?? table.tableNumber ?? tableRef;
              if (table.status !== "AVAILABLE") {
                return {
                  error: `Table ${label} is ${table.status.toLowerCase()}, so the party can't be seated there. Nothing was changed.`,
                };
              }
              await api.reservations.walkIn({
                venueId,
                partySize: entry.partySize,
                tableId: table.id,
                guestName: entry.guestName,
              });
              seatedAt = label;
              await api.waitlist.seat(entry.id);
              return { seated: true, guestName: entry.guestName, table: label };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "seat_waitlist_party failed");
              // The walk-in exists, so the party is seated; only the waitlist row is stale (as WaitlistPage reports it).
              if (seatedAt) {
                return {
                  seated: true,
                  waitlistStale: true,
                  table: seatedAt,
                  note: `The party is seated at ${seatedAt}, but they are still shown on the waitlist. Tell the user to remove them from the Waitlist page.`,
                };
              }
              return waitlistFailure(err, "seat the party");
            }
          },
        }),
    
        remove_from_waitlist: tool({
          description:
            "Take a party off the waitlist (they left or no longer want a table). Requires confirmation.",
          inputSchema: z.object(PartySchema),
          execute: async ({ guestName, partySize }) => {
            if (!venueId) return NO_VENUE;
            log.info({ venueId }, "remove_from_waitlist tool called");
            try {
              const found = await findParty(api, venueId, guestName, partySize);
              if ("error" in found) return found;
              await api.waitlist.cancel(found.entry.id);
              return { removed: true, guestName: found.entry.guestName };
            } catch (err) {
              log.error({ err, venueId }, "remove_from_waitlist failed");
              return waitlistFailure(err, "remove the party");
            }
          },
        }),
      };
    }

    export function agentApiOrigin(apiBaseUrl: string | undefined): string {
      if (!apiBaseUrl) return LOCAL_API_ORIGIN;
      try {
        return new URL(apiBaseUrl).origin;
      } catch {
        return LOCAL_API_ORIGIN;
      }
    }
    function isTimeZone(value: string): boolean {
      try {
        new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", { timeZone: value });
        return true;
      } catch {
        return false;
      }
    }
    export function genAgentSystemPrompt(
      parsed: Pick<AgentPromptContext, "venueId" | "timeZone" | "page" | "focus" | "focusDate">,
      catalogPrompt: string
    ): string {
      return buildAgentSystemPrompt({
        venueId: parsed.venueId,
        timeZone: parsed.timeZone,
        page: parsed.page,
        focus: parsed.focus,
        focusDate: parsed.focusDate,
        now: new Date(),
        catalogPrompt: chatComponentReference(catalogPrompt),
      });
    }
    export const genAgentRoutes = createGenRoute({
      path: "/api/gen/agent",
      costLogLabel: "gen-agent cost log",
      rateLimit: {
        max: 30,
        timeWindow: "1 hour",
      },
      schema: GenAgentBodySchema,
      streamFormat: "ndjson",
      maxSteps: 5,
      getSystemPrompt: genAgentSystemPrompt,
      toMessages: (parsed) =>
        parsed.actionConfirm
          ? [
              ...parsed.messages,
              {
                role: "user" as const,
                content: `I confirm the pending ${parsed.actionConfirm.toolName} action. Execute it now with the confirmed parameters.`,
              },
            ]
          : parsed.messages,
      // On the armed resend the model re-calls the tool being confirmed; emitting
      // its action_request again would pop a stale confirm dialog in the client for
      // a write this request already executes. Other tools' requests still surface.
      createEventSerializer: (parsed) => (event) =>
        event.type === "action_request" && event.toolName === parsed.actionConfirm?.toolName
          ? undefined
          : event,
      getTools: async (request, parsed) => {
        const authHeader = request.headers.authorization;
        const token = authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ") ? authHeader.slice(7) : null;
        const api = createApiClient({
          baseUrl: agentApiOrigin(process.env.API_BASE_URL),
          getAccessToken: () => token,
        });
        return createAgentTools(request.log, api, {
          confirmedAction: parsed.actionConfirm,
          venueId: parsed.venueId,
          timeZone: parsed.timeZone,
        });
      },
    });
