  <file path="src/routes/gen-json-elements.ts">
    export function completeJsonElements(buffer: string): unknown[] {
      const key = buffer.indexOf('"elements"');
      if (key === -1) return [];
      const start = buffer.indexOf("[", key);
      if (start === -1) return [];
    
      const elements: unknown[] = [];
      let index = start + 1;
      while (index < buffer.length) {
        const char = buffer[index];
        if (char === undefined) break;
        if (char === " " || char === "\n" || char === "\r" || char === "\t" || char === ",") {
          index += 1;
          continue;
        }
        if (char === "]") break;
        if (char !== "{") break;
        const end = endOfObject(buffer, index);
        if (end === -1) break;
        try {
          elements.push(JSON.parse(buffer.slice(index, end)) as unknown);
        } catch {
          break;
        }
        index = end;
      }
      return elements;
    }
    function endOfObject(buffer: string, start: number): number {
      let depth = 0;
      let inString = false;
      let escape = false;
      for (let index = start; index < buffer.length; index += 1) {
        const char = buffer[index];
        if (char === undefined) break;
        if (inString) {
          if (escape) {
            escape = false;
            continue;
          }
          if (char === "\\") {
            escape = true;
            continue;
          }
          if (char === '"') inString = false;
          continue;
        }
        if (char === '"') {
          inString = true;
          continue;
        }
        if (char === "{") depth += 1;
        else if (char === "}") {
          depth -= 1;
          if (depth === 0) return index + 1;
        }
      }
      return -1;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/routes/gen-route-factory.ts">
    export interface GenRouteConfig<TSchema extends z.ZodType> {
      readonly path: string;
      /** Exact label passed to logGenCost — preserved per-route for log-query stability. */
      readonly costLogLabel: string;
      readonly rateLimit: { readonly max: number; readonly timeWindow: string };
      readonly schema: TSchema;
      /** "text" → text/plain passthrough; "ndjson" → application/x-ndjson line framing */
      readonly streamFormat: "text" | "ndjson";
      readonly maxSteps: number;
      /** Overrides the catalog prompt (default: catalog.prompt()). */
      readonly systemPrompt?: string;
      /**
       * Per-request system prompt built from the parsed body; receives the catalog
       * prompt to extend. Takes precedence over `systemPrompt`.
       */
      readonly getSystemPrompt?: (parsed: z.infer<TSchema>, catalogPrompt: string) => string;
      readonly toolChoice?: GenRunnerConfig["toolChoice"];
      readonly failOnToolError?: boolean;
      /**
       * ndjson only: serve identical requests from the Postgres spec cache. Only
       * successful runs are stored; a hit replays the exact lines a miss streamed.
       */
      readonly cache?: boolean;
      /** Derives the chat messages from the parsed body (default: `parsed.messages`). */
      readonly toMessages?: (parsed: z.infer<TSchema>) => GenMessages;
      /**
       * ndjson only: maps an event to the value written as one JSON line.
       * Return undefined to drop the event (default: the event itself).
       */
      readonly serializeEvent?: (event: GenStreamEvent) => unknown;
      /**
       * ndjson only: per-request variant of `serializeEvent`, built from the parsed
       * body so it can hold request-scoped state (and throw to fail the run).
       * Takes precedence over `serializeEvent`.
       */
      readonly createEventSerializer?: (parsed: z.infer<TSchema>) => (event: GenStreamEvent) => unknown;
      readonly getTools: (
        request: FastifyRequest,
        parsed: z.infer<TSchema>
      ) => GenToolMap | Promise<GenToolMap>;
    }
    type GenMessages = Array<{ role: "user" | "assistant"; content: string }>;
    function emptyOutputError(): Error & { statusCode: number } {
      return toError(new Error("Generation completed with no output"));
    }
    function generationFailureMessage(err: unknown): string {
      const cause = err instanceof Error && err.cause instanceof Error ? err.cause.message : "";
      const text = `${err instanceof Error ? err.message : ""} ${cause}`;
      if (text.includes("maxOutputTokens")) {
        return "This UI is too large to generate in one pass. Try fewer fields, then generate again.";
      }
      if (text.includes("no output")) {
        return "Generation finished without a UI. Try a simpler description.";
      }
      return "Generation failed before a UI came back. Your prompt is still here — try again.";
    }
    function toError(err: unknown): Error & { statusCode: number } {
      return Object.assign(new Error("Generation failed upstream", { cause: err }), {
        statusCode: 502,
      });
    }
    export function createGenRoute<TSchema extends z.ZodType>(
      config: GenRouteConfig<TSchema>
    ): FastifyPluginAsync {
      const { path, costLogLabel, rateLimit, schema, streamFormat, maxSteps, getTools } = config;
      const defaultSerializeEvent = config.serializeEvent ?? ((event: GenStreamEvent) => event);
    
      const contentType =
        streamFormat === "text" ? "text/plain; charset=utf-8" : "application/x-ndjson; charset=utf-8";
    
      return async (fastify) => {
        // Per-identity cap enforced by hand after requireAuth: a route-level
        // `config.rateLimit` runs at onRequest, before request.user exists, so its
        // keyGenerator always fell back to the IP. createRateLimit bypasses the
        // plugin's one-limiter-per-request flag, so the service-wide limiter keeps
        // covering the anonymous surface.
        const identityLimiter = fastify.createRateLimit({
          max: rateLimit.max,
          timeWindow: rateLimit.timeWindow,
          keyGenerator: (request: FastifyRequest) => request.user?.id ?? request.ip,
        });
    
        const enforceIdentityLimit: preHandlerAsyncHookHandler = async (request, reply) => {
          const limit = await identityLimiter(request);
          if (limit.isAllowed || !limit.isExceeded) return;
    
          reply.header("Retry-After", limit.ttlInSeconds);
          return reply
            .code(429)
            .send(
              createProblemDetails(
                429,
                "Too Many Requests",
                `Rate limit exceeded. Retry after ${limit.ttlInSeconds} seconds.`
              )
            );
        };
    
        // Aggregate ceiling across ALL identities, ordered after requireAuth and the
        // identity limiter so anonymous and per-user refusals keep their own answers.
        // Distinct problem type: a service-wide stop is not a per-user rate limit.
        const enforceSpendCeiling: preHandlerAsyncHookHandler = async (request, reply) => {
          const ceilingUsd = getGenDailyCeilingUsd();
          const ceilingMicroUsd = Math.round(ceilingUsd * 1_000_000);
          const retryAfter = secondsUntilNextWindow();
    
          let spend;
          try {
            if (isSpendTrackingDegraded()) throw new Error("usage writes are failing");
            spend = await getGenSpendToday();
          } catch (err) {
            // Unknown spend must not read as zero spend: fail closed.
            request.log.error({ err }, "gen spend ceiling: counter unreadable, refusing");
            reply.header("Retry-After", retryAfter);
            return reply
              .code(503)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  503,
                  "Service Unavailable",
                  "Generation is temporarily unavailable.",
                  "urn:mbe:problem:gen-spend-ceiling-unavailable"
                )
              );
          }
    
          if (spend.costMicroUsd < ceilingMicroUsd) return;
    
          request.log.warn(
            {
              window: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
              ceilingUsd,
              accumulatedUsd: spend.costMicroUsd / 1_000_000,
              generations: spend.generations,
            },
            "gen spend ceiling reached, refusing generation"
          );
          reply.header("Retry-After", retryAfter);
          return reply
            .code(503)
            .send(
              createProblemDetails(
                503,
                "Service Spend Ceiling Reached",
                `The service's daily generation ceiling has been reached. Retry after ${retryAfter} seconds.`,
                "urn:mbe:problem:gen-spend-ceiling-reached"
              )
            );
        };
    
        fastify.post(
          path,
          {
            preHandler: [requireAuth, enforceIdentityLimit, enforceSpendCeiling],
          },
          async (request, reply) => {
            const parseResult = schema.safeParse(request.body);
            if (!parseResult.success) {
              return reply
                .code(400)
                .send(
                  createProblemDetails(
                    400,
                    "Bad Request",
                    (parseResult.error as z.ZodError).issues.map((i) => i.message).join(", ")
                  )
                );
            }
    
            const parsed = parseResult.data;
            const messages = config.toMessages
              ? config.toMessages(parsed)
              : (parsed as { messages: GenMessages }).messages;
    
            const systemPrompt = config.getSystemPrompt
              ? config.getSystemPrompt(parsed, SYSTEM_PROMPT)
              : (config.systemPrompt ?? SYSTEM_PROMPT);
            const cacheKey =
              config.cache && streamFormat === "ndjson"
                ? genSpecCacheKey({
                    route: path,
                    messages,
                    modelId: GEN_MODEL_ID,
                    systemPrompt,
                    maxOutputTokens: GEN_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
                  })
                : undefined;
    
            if (cacheKey) {
              // Cache trouble must never fail a request: fall through to the model.
              const cached = await getCachedSpec(cacheKey).catch((err: unknown) => {
                request.log.warn({ err }, "gen spec cache read failed");
                return null;
              });
              if (cached) {
                applyStreamHeaders(reply, contentType);
                return reply.send(
                  new ReadableStream({
                    start(controller) {
                      // Same leading blank line a miss writes, so a hit is byte-identical.
                      controller.enqueue(encoder.encode("\n"));
                      for (const line of cached) {
                        controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(line) + "\n"));
                      }
                      controller.close();
                    },
                  })
                );
              }
            }
    
            const startedAt = Date.now();
            let firstEventAt: number | undefined;
            let elementCount = 0;
            const markEmitted = () => {
              firstEventAt ??= Date.now();
              elementCount += 1;
            };
            const telemetry = (finishReason: string) => ({
              ttftMs: firstEventAt === undefined ? 0 : firstEventAt - startedAt,
              durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
              elementCount,
              finishReason,
            });
    
            const tools = await getTools(request, parsed);
            // A run that errors before onFinish still consumed tokens: charge the worst case.
            let usageReported = false;
            const chargeIfUnreported = async (finishReason = "error") => {
              if (usageReported) return;
              // Claim the charge first so a late onFinish cannot charge the run twice.
              usageReported = true;
              // onFinish never logged this run, so the cost line is emitted here, zeroed.
              logGenCost(request.log, {
                userId: request.user?.id,
                usage: {},
                label: costLogLabel,
                telemetry: telemetry(finishReason),
              });
              await trackGenSpend(failedGenCostMicroUsd(), request.log);
            };
            // Fired when the client disconnects (the response stream is cancelled),
            // so the model call stops instead of spending tokens nobody will read.
            const clientGone = new AbortController();
            const runner = createGenRunner({
              systemPrompt,
              modelId: GEN_MODEL_ID,
              maxOutputTokens: GEN_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
              maxSteps,
              toolChoice: config.toolChoice,
              failOnToolError: config.failOnToolError,
              onFinish: async ({ usage, providerMetadata, finishReason }) => {
                // Already charged the worst case (aborted or failed first): never charge twice.
                if (usageReported) return;
                logGenCost(request.log, {
                  userId: request.user?.id,
                  usage,
                  providerMetadata,
                  label: costLogLabel,
                  telemetry: telemetry(finishReason ?? "unknown"),
                });
                usageReported = true;
                await trackGenSpend(genCostMicroUsd(usage, providerMetadata), request.log);
              },
            });
    
            applyStreamHeaders(reply, contentType);
    
            if (streamFormat === "text") {
              const textStream = new ReadableStream<string>({
                async start(controller) {
                  let emitted = false;
                  try {
                    await runner.run(
                      messages,
                      tools,
                      async (event) => {
                        if (clientGone.signal.aborted) return;
                        if (event.type === "text" && event.content.length > 0) {
                          emitted = true;
                          markEmitted();
                          controller.enqueue(event.content);
                        }
                      },
                      clientGone.signal
                    );
                    if (clientGone.signal.aborted) {
                      await chargeIfUnreported("aborted");
                      return;
                    }
                    if (!emitted) throw emptyOutputError();
                    controller.close();
                  } catch (err) {
                    if (clientGone.signal.aborted) {
                      await chargeIfUnreported("aborted");
                      return;
                    }
                    // Error the stream — closing here would turn an upstream
                    // failure (e.g. 529/401) into an empty-looking 200.
                    request.log.error({ err }, "gen stream failed");
                    await chargeIfUnreported();
                    controller.error(toError(err));
                  }
                },
                cancel() {
                  clientGone.abort();
                },
              });
              return reply.send(createSanitizedStream(textStream));
            }
    
            // ndjson: encode each event as a JSON line.
            // A blank line goes out immediately and every 10s. DigitalOcean's
            // gateway answers 504 when a request sits with no bytes (the model
            // thinks, then emits one tool call). Blank lines are not elements.
            // Once any byte is flushed the status is committed, so a later failure
            // is a `$genError` line the client throws on — not a silent 200.
            const serializeEvent = config.createEventSerializer?.(parsed) ?? defaultSerializeEvent;
            // Shared with cancel(): once the client is gone nothing may touch the controller.
            let closed = false;
            let pulse: ReturnType<typeof setInterval> | undefined;
            const ndjsonStream = new ReadableStream({
              async start(controller) {
                let emitted = false;
                let sent = false;
                const lines: unknown[] = [];
                const write = (bytes: Uint8Array) => {
                  if (closed) return;
                  try {
                    controller.enqueue(bytes);
                    sent = true;
                  } catch {
                    // The stream closed under us (client gone): a late write is dropped,
                    // never thrown — from the pulse's setInterval it would be uncaught.
                    closed = true;
                    clearInterval(pulse);
                  }
                };
                write(encoder.encode("\n"));
                pulse = setInterval(() => write(encoder.encode("\n")), 10_000);
                const end = (errorLine?: string) => {
                  if (closed) return;
                  closed = true;
                  clearInterval(pulse);
                  if (errorLine !== undefined) controller.enqueue(encoder.encode(errorLine));
                  controller.close();
                };
                try {
                  await runner.run(
                    messages,
                    tools,
                    async (event) => {
                      const line = serializeEvent(event);
                      if (line === undefined) return;
                      emitted = true;
                      markEmitted();
                      lines.push(line);
                      write(encoder.encode(JSON.stringify(line) + "\n"));
                    },
                    clientGone.signal
                  );
                  // An aborted run is partial: charge it, never cache it.
                  if (clientGone.signal.aborted) {
                    await chargeIfUnreported("aborted");
                    return;
                  }
                  if (!emitted) throw emptyOutputError();
                  // Only a run that finished cleanly reaches here: errors and the
                  // maxOutputTokens truncation both throw out of runner.run above.
                  if (cacheKey) {
                    await putCachedSpec(cacheKey, lines).catch((err: unknown) => {
                      request.log.warn({ err }, "gen spec cache write failed");
                    });
                  }
                  end();
                } catch (err) {
                  if (clientGone.signal.aborted) {
                    await chargeIfUnreported("aborted");
                    return;
                  }
                  request.log.error({ err }, "gen stream failed");
                  await chargeIfUnreported();
                  if (!sent) {
                    closed = true;
                    clearInterval(pulse);
                    controller.error(toError(err));
                    return;
                  }
                  end(JSON.stringify({ $genError: generationFailureMessage(err) }) + "\n");
                } finally {
                  clearInterval(pulse);
                }
              },
              cancel() {
                // Fastify cancels the reader when the client disconnects.
                closed = true;
                clearInterval(pulse);
                clientGone.abort();
              },
            });
            return reply.send(ndjsonStream);
          }
        );
      };
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/routes/gen-runner.ts">
    export type GenStreamEvent =
      | { readonly type: "text"; readonly content: string }
      | { readonly type: "element"; readonly element: unknown }
      | {
          readonly type: "action_request";
          readonly actionId: string;
          readonly toolName: string;
          readonly toolInput: unknown;
        }
      | {
          readonly type: "tool_status";
          readonly tool: string;
          readonly status: "running" | "complete";
        }
      | {
          readonly type: "permission_denied";
          readonly toolName: string;
          readonly reason: string;
        };
    export interface GenFinishPayload {
      readonly usage: { readonly inputTokens?: number; readonly outputTokens?: number };
      readonly providerMetadata: unknown;
      readonly finishReason?: string;
    }
    export interface GenRunnerConfig {
      readonly systemPrompt: string;
      readonly modelId: string;
      /** Output-token ceiling per model call; hitting it fails the run (never a partial result). */
      readonly maxOutputTokens: number;
      readonly maxSteps: number;
      readonly onFinish?: (payload: GenFinishPayload) => Promise<void>;
      /**
       * Forces a specific tool call (e.g. `{ type: "tool", toolName: "render_component" }`)
       * instead of leaving tool use to the model's discretion. Omit to keep the
       * provider's default ("auto") behavior — existing callers are unaffected.
       */
      readonly toolChoice?: { readonly type: "tool"; readonly toolName: string };
      /**
       * When true, a `tool-error` part (schema-invalid tool input) throws
       * immediately instead of letting it pass. Only safe when maxSteps === 1
       * (no possible retry) — gen-ui sets this. With maxSteps > 1, ai@7's own
       * multi-step loop resends the tool error to the model and can recover on a
       * later step via the SAME fullStream; throwing unconditionally there would
       * kill the turn before that recovery ever runs (verified against the real
       * SDK — gen-agent regressed this way when the throw was unconditional).
       * Leave unset for any runner where maxSteps > 1.
       */
      readonly failOnToolError?: boolean;
    }
    export const GEN_WRITE_TOOL_NAMES = [
      "create_reservation",
      "modify_reservation",
      "cancel_reservation",
      "seat_walk_in",
      "update_table_status",
      "change_tonight_availability",
      "end_tonight_change",
      "undo_availability_change",
      "add_to_waitlist",
      "notify_waitlist_party",
      "seat_waitlist_party",
      "remove_from_waitlist",
      "seat_reservation",
      "mark_no_show",
    ] as const;
    export type GenToolMap = Record<string, unknown>;
    export type GenEventCallback = (event: GenStreamEvent) => Promise<void>;
    export interface GenRunner {
      run(
        messages: ReadonlyArray<{ role: "user" | "assistant"; content: string }>,
        tools: GenToolMap,
        onEvent: GenEventCallback,
        /** Aborts the model call, e.g. when the client disconnects mid-stream. */
        signal?: AbortSignal
      ): Promise<void>;
    }
    export function createGenRunner(config: GenRunnerConfig): GenRunner {
      return {
        async run(messages, tools, onEvent, signal) {
          const result = streamText({
            model: anthropic(config.modelId),
            abortSignal: signal,
            // System prompt goes through `instructions` — ai@7 rejects system-role
            // entries inside `messages` (see genSystemInstructions).
            instructions: genSystemInstructions(config.systemPrompt),
            messages: [...messages],
            tools: tools as Parameters<typeof streamText>[0]["tools"],
            toolChoice: config.toolChoice,
            stopWhen: stepCountIs(config.maxSteps),
            maxOutputTokens: config.maxOutputTokens,
            providerOptions: {
              anthropic: {
                // Haiku 5.5 thinks before the tool call, and those tokens count
                // against the output cap. Nothing is emitted until thinking
                // finishes, so a large form sits silent until the gateway 504s.
                thinking: { type: "disabled" },
                toolStreaming: true,
              },
            },
            onFinish: config.onFinish
              ? async ({ usage, providerMetadata, finishReason }) => {
                  await config.onFinish!({ usage, providerMetadata, finishReason });
                }
              : undefined,
          });
    
          // Text from a later step (after a tool call) would otherwise run straight
          // on from the previous step's: "…for 2 people:Monday's slots…" (F29).
          let textSoFar = false;
          let stepEnded = false;
          let renderJson = "";
          let renderEmitted = 0;
          let trackingRender = false;
          for await (const event of result.fullStream) {
            if (event.type === "tool-input-start" && event.toolName === "render_component") {
              trackingRender = true;
              renderJson = "";
              renderEmitted = 0;
            } else if (event.type === "tool-input-delta" && trackingRender) {
              renderJson += event.delta;
              const ready = completeJsonElements(renderJson);
              for (const element of ready.slice(renderEmitted)) {
                await onEvent({ type: "element", element });
              }
              renderEmitted = ready.length;
            } else if (event.type === "text-delta") {
              const content = textSoFar && stepEnded ? `\n\n${event.text}` : event.text;
              textSoFar = true;
              stepEnded = false;
              await onEvent({ type: "text", content });
            } else if (event.type === "finish-step" && event.finishReason !== "length") {
              stepEnded = true;
            } else if (event.type === "tool-call") {
              const already =
                trackingRender && event.toolName === "render_component" ? renderEmitted : 0;
              await handleToolCall(event, onEvent, already);
              if (event.toolName === "render_component") trackingRender = false;
            } else if (event.type === "tool-result") {
              await onEvent({
                type: "tool_status",
                tool: event.toolName,
                status: "complete",
              });
            } else if (
              (event.type === "finish-step" || event.type === "finish") &&
              event.finishReason === "length"
            ) {
              // The output-token cap truncated the response (thinking tokens
              // count against it). Fail rather than hand the client a partial
              // element list; the route factory's error path logs this message.
              throw new Error(
                `gen output truncated: hit maxOutputTokens (${config.maxOutputTokens}) cap`
              );
            } else if (event.type === "error") {
              // ai@7 does not throw on a failed model call (e.g. 529/401) — it
              // yields this part and completes the stream normally. Without this,
              // the loop just finishes: the caller sees a clean return and zero
              // events, indistinguishable from "nothing to generate" rather than
              // "the call failed". Always fatal — there is no recovery from a
              // failed model call.
              throw toError(event.error);
            } else if (event.type === "tool-error" && config.failOnToolError) {
              // Unlike `error`, a `tool-error` (schema-invalid tool input) is
              // NOT always fatal: with maxSteps > 1, ai@7 resends it to the model
              // and a later step can recover on this same fullStream. Only throw
              // when the caller has said no retry is possible (see
              // GenRunnerConfig.failOnToolError).
              throw toError(event.error);
            }
          }
        },
      };
    }
    function toError(value: unknown): Error {
      return value instanceof Error ? value : new Error(String(value));
    }
    async function handleToolCall(
      event: { toolCallId: string; toolName: string; input: unknown; invalid?: boolean },
      onEvent: GenEventCallback,
      alreadyEmitted = 0
    ): Promise<void> {
      const { toolName, toolCallId, input } = event;
    
      // Permission check: blocked tool names (policy from agent-core)
      if (GEN_BLOCKED_TOOLS.has(toolName)) {
        await onEvent({
          type: "permission_denied",
          toolName,
          reason: `Tool "${toolName}" is not allowed in gen sessions`,
        });
        return;
      }
    
      // Permission check: bash command patterns (policy from agent-core)
      if (toolName === "Bash") {
        const command = (input as Record<string, unknown>).command as string | undefined;
        if (command) {
          const blockReason = genIsBashCommandBlocked(command);
          if (blockReason) {
            await onEvent({ type: "permission_denied", toolName, reason: blockReason });
            return;
          }
        }
      }
    
      // render_component emits element events (no status — handled by tool-result)
      if (toolName === "render_component") {
        const typedInput = input as { elements?: unknown[] };
        for (const element of (typedInput.elements ?? []).slice(alreadyEmitted)) {
          await onEvent({ type: "element", element });
        }
        return;
      }
    
      // Write tools emit action_request (require user confirmation). A schema-invalid
      // call never executes, and the SDK resends its error to the model: no confirm bar.
      if (GEN_WRITE_TOOLS.has(toolName)) {
        if (event.invalid) return;
        await onEvent({
          type: "action_request",
          actionId: toolCallId,
          toolName,
          toolInput: input,
        });
        return;
      }
    
      // Read/status tools emit running status
      await onEvent({ type: "tool_status", tool: toolName, status: "running" });
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/routes/gen-specs.ts">
    function normaliseKind(
      prompt: string,
      kind: (typeof GEN_SPEC_KINDS)[number] | undefined
    ): { prompt: string; kind: (typeof GEN_SPEC_KINDS)[number] } {
      if (kind) return { prompt, kind };
      for (const [prefix, derived] of LEGACY_PREFIXES) {
        if (prompt.startsWith(prefix) && prompt.length > prefix.length) {
          return { prompt: prompt.slice(prefix.length), kind: derived };
        }
      }
      return { prompt, kind: "generate" };
    }
    export const genSpecsRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      // POST /api/gen/specs — create and persist a spec (auth required)
      fastify.post(
        "/api/gen/specs",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth],
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          const parseResult = CreateSpecBodySchema.safeParse(request.body);
          if (!parseResult.success) {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  400,
                  "Bad Request",
                  parseResult.error.issues.map((i) => i.message).join(", ")
                )
              );
          }
    
          const { spec, rawLines, refinement } = parseResult.data;
          const { prompt, kind } = normaliseKind(parseResult.data.prompt, parseResult.data.kind);
    
          if (refinement && kind !== "refine") {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(400, "Bad Request", "refinement is only allowed on refine entries")
              );
          }
    
          try {
            const result = await storedSpecService.create({
              userId: request.user!.id,
              prompt,
              kind,
              spec,
              rawLines,
              refinement,
            });
    
            return reply.code(201).send({ data: mapStoredSpec(result) });
          } catch (err) {
            if (err instanceof Error && err.message === "Not found") {
              return reply
                .code(404)
                .send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Parent spec not found"));
            }
            throw err;
          }
        }
      );
    
      // GET /api/gen/specs — list user's specs sorted by createdAt DESC (auth required)
      fastify.get(
        "/api/gen/specs",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth],
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          const results = await storedSpecService.list(request.user!.id);
          return reply.code(200).send({ data: results.map(mapStoredSpec) });
        }
      );
    
      // GET /api/gen/specs/:id — PUBLIC — no auth required for permalink viewing
      fastify.get("/api/gen/specs/:id", async (request, reply) => {
        const { id } = request.params as { id: string };
        const result = await storedSpecService.getById(id);
    
        if (!result) {
          return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Spec not found"));
        }
    
        return reply.code(200).send({ data: mapStoredSpecPublic(result) });
      });
    
      // PATCH /api/gen/specs/:id/favorite — toggle isFavorite for the owner (auth required)
      fastify.patch(
        "/api/gen/specs/:id/favorite",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth],
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          const { id } = request.params as { id: string };
    
          try {
            const result = await storedSpecService.toggleFavorite(id, request.user!.id);
            return reply.code(200).send({ data: mapStoredSpec(result) });
          } catch (err) {
            if (err instanceof Error && err.message === "Not found") {
              return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Spec not found"));
            }
            throw err;
          }
        }
      );
    
      // DELETE /api/gen/specs/:id — remove a spec for the owner (auth required)
      fastify.delete(
        "/api/gen/specs/:id",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth],
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          const { id } = request.params as { id: string };
    
          try {
            await storedSpecService.delete(id, request.user!.id);
            return reply.code(204).send();
          } catch (err) {
            if (err instanceof Error && err.message === "Not found") {
              return reply.code(404).send(createProblemDetails(404, "Not Found", "Spec not found"));
            }
            throw err;
          }
        }
      );
    };

    export function genSystemInstructions(systemPrompt: string) {
      return {
        role: "system" as const,
        content: systemPrompt,
        providerOptions: { anthropic: { cacheControl: { type: "ephemeral" as const } } },

    interface GenUsage {
      readonly inputTokens?: number;
      readonly outputTokens?: number;
      readonly inputTokenDetails?: {
        readonly cacheReadTokens?: number;
        readonly cacheWriteTokens?: number;
      };
    }
    export function cacheTokens(
      usage: GenUsage,
      providerMetadata: unknown
    ): { readonly read: number; readonly write: number } {
      const meta = (
        providerMetadata as
          | {
              anthropic?: {
                usage?: { cache_read_input_tokens?: number; cache_creation_input_tokens?: number };
                cacheReadInputTokens?: number;
                cacheCreationInputTokens?: number;
              };
            }
          | undefined
      )?.anthropic;
      return {
        read:
          usage.inputTokenDetails?.cacheReadTokens ??
          meta?.usage?.cache_read_input_tokens ??
          meta?.cacheReadInputTokens ??
          0,
        write:
          usage.inputTokenDetails?.cacheWriteTokens ??
          meta?.usage?.cache_creation_input_tokens ??
          meta?.cacheCreationInputTokens ??
          0,
      };
    }
    export interface GenTelemetry {
      /** ms from request start to the first emitted event (0 if none was emitted). */
      readonly ttftMs: number;
      /** ms from request start to the run finishing or failing. */
      readonly durationMs: number;
      readonly elementCount: number;
      /** The AI SDK's finish reason, or "error" for a failed run. */
      readonly finishReason: string;
    }
    export function logGenCost(
      log: FastifyBaseLogger,
      opts: {
        readonly userId?: string;
        readonly usage: GenUsage;
        readonly providerMetadata?: unknown;
        readonly label: string;
        readonly telemetry?: GenTelemetry;
      }
    ): void {
      const cache = cacheTokens(opts.usage, opts.providerMetadata);
    
      log.info(
        {
          userId: opts.userId,
          modelId: GEN_MODEL_ID,
          inputTokens: opts.usage.inputTokens ?? 0,
          outputTokens: opts.usage.outputTokens ?? 0,
          cacheReadInputTokens: cache.read,
          cacheCreationInputTokens: cache.write,
          ttftMs: opts.telemetry?.ttftMs ?? 0,
          durationMs: opts.telemetry?.durationMs ?? 0,
          elementCount: opts.telemetry?.elementCount ?? 0,
          finishReason: opts.telemetry?.finishReason ?? "unknown",
        },
        opts.label
      );
    }
    export function applyStreamHeaders(reply: FastifyReply, contentType: string): void {
      reply.header("Content-Type", contentType);
      reply.header("Cache-Control", "no-cache");
      reply.header("Connection", "keep-alive");
      reply.header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no");
    }

    export type ApiClient = ReturnType<typeof createApiClient>;
    export const NO_VENUE = {
      error: "No venue is selected. Ask the user to pick a venue in the app, then try again.",
    } as const;
    export function todayIn(timeZone: string | undefined, now: Date = new Date()): string {
      return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-CA", {
        timeZone: timeZone ?? "UTC",
        year: "numeric",
        month: "2-digit",
        day: "2-digit",
      }).format(now);
    }
    export function localTimeIn(iso: unknown, timeZone: string | undefined): string | undefined {
      if (typeof iso !== "string") return undefined;
      const instant = new Date(iso);
      if (Number.isNaN(instant.getTime())) return undefined;
      try {
        return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-GB", {
          timeZone: timeZone ?? "UTC",
          hour: "2-digit",
          minute: "2-digit",
          hourCycle: "h23",
        }).format(instant);
      } catch {
        return undefined; // unknown time zone (RangeError)
      }
    }
    export interface Refusal {
      readonly status: number;
      readonly detail: string;
      readonly code?: string;
      readonly reason?: string;
    }
    export function refusalOf(err: unknown): Refusal | undefined {
      const problem = (err as { problemDetails?: Record<string, unknown> } | null)?.problemDetails;
      const status = problem?.["status"];
      if (typeof status !== "number" || status < 400 || status >= 500) return undefined;
      if (status === 408 || status === 429) return undefined;
      const { detail, code, reason } = problem as Record<string, unknown>;
      return {
        status,
        detail: typeof detail === "string" && detail ? detail : `The request was refused (${status}).`,
        ...(typeof code === "string" ? { code } : {}),
        ...(typeof reason === "string" ? { reason } : {}),
      };
    }
    export interface NamedTable {
      readonly id: string;
      readonly name?: string | null;
      readonly tableNumber?: string | null;
    }
    export function resolveTable<T extends NamedTable>(
      tables: readonly T[],
      tableRef: string
    ): { table: T } | { error: string } {
      const ref = tableRef.trim();
      const steps: ReadonlyArray<(t: T) => boolean> = [
        (t) => t.tableNumber === ref,
        (t) => t.name === ref,
        (t) => t.name?.toLowerCase() === ref.toLowerCase(),
      ];
      for (const matches of steps) {
        const found = tables.filter(matches);
        if (found.length === 1) return { table: found[0]! };
        if (found.length > 1) {
          return { error: `Table ${tableRef} is ambiguous in this venue. Ask which table they mean.` };
        }
      }
      return { error: `Table ${tableRef} not found in this venue.` };
    }

  <file path="src/routes/gen-ui.ts">
    type GenUiBody = z.infer<typeof GenUiBodySchema>;
    function scopedInstruction(target: { key: string; type: string }): string {
      return (
        `Scope: regenerate ONLY the replacement subtree for the selected ${target.type} element. ` +
        `Its root element MUST use key === ${JSON.stringify(target.key)} and omit \`parentKey\`. ` +
        "Use only catalog components, emit exactly one root, and keep every change within that subtree."
      );
    }
    function createTargetGuard(targetKey: string) {
      let seen = 0;
      return (event: GenStreamEvent): unknown => {
        const raw = serializeElement(event);
        if (raw === undefined) return undefined;
        // The render_component input schema guarantees this shape at runtime.
        const element = raw as { key: string; parentKey?: string | null };
        if (seen === 0 && element.key !== targetKey) {
          throw new Error(`Subtree root key "${element.key}" does not match target "${targetKey}"`);
        }
        if (seen > 0 && element.parentKey == null) {
          throw new Error("Subtree generation emitted a second root element");
        }
        seen += 1;
        return element;
      };
    }
    function createRenderComponentTool() {
      return tool({
        description:
          "Render the generated UI as a tree of rialto catalog components. Call once with the complete list of elements.",
        inputSchema: z.object({
          elements: z.array(
            z.object({
              key: z.string(),
              parentKey: z.string().nullable().optional(),
              type: z.string(),
              props: z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()).optional(),
              visible: VisibilityConditionStrictSchema.optional(),
            })
          ),
        }),
        execute: async () => ({ rendered: true }),
      });
    }
    export const genUiRoutes = createGenRoute({
      path: "/api/gen/ui",
      costLogLabel: "gen-ui cost log",
      // Per-user cap — matches gen-agent's per-route rate limit pattern.
      rateLimit: { max: 20, timeWindow: "1 hour" },
      schema: GenUiBodySchema,
      streamFormat: "ndjson",
      maxSteps: 1,
      systemPrompt: SYSTEM_PROMPT,
      // Force the tool call — without this, the model may just answer with text
      // (ignoring the tool entirely) and the route would stream zero elements.
      toolChoice: { type: "tool", toolName: "render_component" },
      // Safe here specifically because maxSteps is 1: there is no later step for
      // ai@7 to retry the tool call on, so a tool-error can only ever mean the
      // generation failed outright. gen-agent (maxSteps 5) must NOT set this.
      failOnToolError: true,
      cache: true,
      toMessages: ({ prompt, context, target }: GenUiBody) => [
        {
          role: "user",
          content: [
            prompt,
            context ? `Context: ${JSON.stringify(context)}` : undefined,
            target ? scopedInstruction(target) : undefined,
          ]
            .filter((part) => part !== undefined)
            .join("\n\n"),
        },
      ],
      createEventSerializer: ({ target }: GenUiBody) =>
        target ? createTargetGuard(target.key) : serializeElement,
      getTools: () => ({ render_component: createRenderComponentTool() }),
    });

  <file path="src/routes/orchestrate.ts">
    interface OrchestrateBody {
      taskDescription: string;
      model?: string;
      sessionModel?: string;
      maxBudgetPerSession?: number;
      maxTurnsPerSession?: number;
      baseBranch?: string;
      maxConcurrentSessions?: number;
    }
    interface OrchestrateResponse {
      parentSessionId: string;
      status: OrchestratorResult["status"];
      childSessionIds: readonly string[];
      summary: string;
      totalCostUsd: number;
      durationMs: number;
    }
    export const orchestrateRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      // POST /v1/orchestrate — Decompose a task into sub-sessions
      fastify.post<{
        Body: OrchestrateBody;
        Reply: ApiResponse<OrchestrateResponse> | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/",
        {
          preHandler: [requireAuth],
          schema: {
            summary: "Orchestrate a complex task",
            operationId: "orchestrateTask",
            description:
              "Decomposes a complex task into independent sub-tasks, creates agent sessions " +
              "for each, monitors them to completion, and returns a synthesis.",
            tags: ["Orchestration"],
            body: {
              type: "object",
              required: ["taskDescription"],
              properties: {
                taskDescription: { type: "string", minLength: 1 },
                model: {
                  type: "string",
                  description: "Model for the orchestrator agent",
                },
                sessionModel: {
                  type: "string",
                  description: "Model for child coding sessions",
                },
                maxBudgetPerSession: {
                  type: "number",
                  minimum: 0.01,
                  maximum: 10.0,
                  description: "Budget cap per child session in USD",
                },
                maxTurnsPerSession: {
                  type: "number",
                  minimum: 1,
                  maximum: 200,
                  description: "Max turns per child session",
                },
                baseBranch: { type: "string" },
                maxConcurrentSessions: {
                  type: "number",
                  minimum: 1,
                  maximum: 10,
                  description: "Max child sessions to run in parallel",
                },
              },
            },
            response: {
              200: {
                description: "Orchestration result",
                type: "object",
                properties: {
                  data: {
                    type: "object",
                    properties: {
                      parentSessionId: { type: "string" },
                      status: {
                        type: "string",
                        enum: ["succeeded", "failed", "partially_succeeded", "in_progress"],
                      },
                      childSessionIds: {
                        type: "array",
                        items: { type: "string" },
                      },
                      summary: { type: "string" },
                      totalCostUsd: { type: "number" },
                      durationMs: { type: "number" },
                    },
                  },
                },
              },
              400: { $ref: "AgentProblemDetails#" },
              429: { $ref: "AgentProblemDetails#" },
            },
          },
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          const { taskDescription, ...overrides } = request.body;
    
          // Admit through the same gate POST /v1/sessions uses (#5148). The
          // orchestrator's parent IS an agent session — it holds a request thread
          // for the whole blocking call and runs its own `query` loop — so it has
          // to consume a slot, not merely check for one. A `canStart()`-only check
          // would be decorative here: parents would never enter the active set, so
          // it could never go false however many orchestrations were in flight.
          //
          // The slot is keyed on a provisional id, not the parent session id,
          // because nothing else manages this session's lifecycle — it never goes
          // through executeSession, so the liveness monitor could otherwise
          // release the slot out from under a still-running orchestration.
          const slotId = `orchestrate:${randomUUID()}`;
          if (!defaultConcurrency.acquire(slotId)) {
            return reply
              .code(429)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  429,
                  "Too Many Requests",
                  `Maximum concurrent sessions (${defaultConcurrency.limit}) reached. Try again later.`
                )
              );
          }
    
          try {
            // Resolve the API base URL — the orchestrator calls back into this service
            const port = process.env.PORT ?? "3003";
            const apiBaseUrl = process.env.AGENT_API_URL ?? `http://localhost:${port}`;
    
            // Create a parent session to track the orchestration. Stamp the
            // authenticated caller's id — sourced exclusively from the verified
            // auth context (requireAuth preHandler, mandatory on this route) —
            // the same pattern POST /v1/sessions uses, so the caller who starts
            // the orchestration can read/cancel/delete it afterward instead of
            // getting a 404 from requireSessionAccess's null-owner deny.
            const parentSession = await sessionService.create({
              taskDescription: `[Orchestrator] ${taskDescription}`,
              model: overrides.model ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.model,
              maxTurns: 200,
              maxBudgetUsd:
                (overrides.maxBudgetPerSession ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.maxBudgetPerSession) *
                (overrides.maxConcurrentSessions ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.maxConcurrentSessions) *
                2,
              userId: request.user?.id,
            });
    
            await sessionService.updateStatus(parentSession.id, "RUNNING");
            await sessionService.addEvent(parentSession.id, "orchestrator:start", {
              message: `Decomposing: ${taskDescription}`,
            });
    
            // Run orchestrator (blocking — this is a long-running request)
            const result = await runOrchestrator(
              {
                taskDescription,
                apiBaseUrl,
                // Sub-session calls hit this service's own requireAuth routes —
                // forward the caller's verified bearer token or every call 401s.
                getAccessToken: () => bearerToken(request.headers.authorization),
                parentSessionId: parentSession.id,
                model: overrides.model ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.model,
                sessionModel: overrides.sessionModel ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.sessionModel,
                maxBudgetPerSession:
                  overrides.maxBudgetPerSession ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.maxBudgetPerSession,
                maxTurnsPerSession:
                  overrides.maxTurnsPerSession ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.maxTurnsPerSession,
                baseBranch: overrides.baseBranch ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.baseBranch,
                maxConcurrentSessions:
                  overrides.maxConcurrentSessions ?? DEFAULT_ORCHESTRATOR_CONFIG.maxConcurrentSessions,
              },
              async (event) => {
                await sessionService.addEvent(parentSession.id, event.type, {
                  message: event.message,
                });
              }
            );
    
            // Update parent session with final status. "in_progress" means children are still
            // running/pending — leave the parent RUNNING rather than falsely marking it FAILED.
            const finalStatus =
              result.status === "succeeded"
                ? "SUCCEEDED"
                : result.status === "in_progress"
                  ? "RUNNING"
                  : "FAILED";
            await sessionService.updateStatus(parentSession.id, finalStatus, {
              resultText: result.summary,
              costUsd: result.totalCostUsd,
              durationMs: result.durationMs,
            });
    
            await sessionService.addEvent(parentSession.id, "orchestrator:complete", {
              status: result.status,
              childSessionIds: result.childSessionIds,
              totalCostUsd: result.totalCostUsd,
            });
    
            return reply.code(200).send({
              data: {
                parentSessionId: parentSession.id,
                status: result.status,
                childSessionIds: result.childSessionIds,
                summary: result.summary,
                totalCostUsd: result.totalCostUsd,
                durationMs: result.durationMs,
              },
            });
          } finally {
            // Releasing in `finally` matters more than the acquire: a leaked
            // slot is permanent, shrinking capacity for the process lifetime.
            defaultConcurrency.release(slotId);
          }
        }
      );
    };
    function bearerToken(header: string | undefined): string | null {
      return header?.startsWith("Bearer ") ? header.slice(7) : null;
    }
  </file>
  <file path="src/routes/remediation.ts">
    type AlertPayload = z.infer<typeof AlertPayloadSchema>;
    export const remediationRoutes: FastifyPluginAsync = async (fastify) => {
      fastify.addHook("preParsing", createRawBodyCaptureHook());
      fastify.addHook(
        "preHandler",
        createVerifiedBodyPreHandler({
          header: "x-remediation-signature",
          secretEnv: "REMEDIATION_WEBHOOK_SECRET",
          format: "raw",
        })
      );
    
      // github[js/missing-rate-limiting] — strict limit to prevent alert storms
      fastify.post<{
        Body: unknown;
        Reply: { sessionId: string } | ProblemDetails;
      }>(
        "/remediation",
        {
          schema: {
            summary: "Remediation webhook receiver",
            operationId: "handleRemediationWebhook",
            description:
              "Receives monitoring alerts (Grafana, PagerDuty, etc.) and triggers " +
              "agent investigation sessions. Circuit breaker prevents alert storms.",
            tags: ["Webhooks"],
            response: {
              200: {
                type: "object",
                properties: { sessionId: { type: "string" } },
              },
              400: { $ref: "AgentProblemDetails#" },
              401: { $ref: "AgentProblemDetails#" },
              503: { $ref: "AgentProblemDetails#" },
            },
          },
          config: { rateLimit: { max: 5, timeWindow: "1 minute" } },
        },
        async (request, reply) => {
          // 1. Validate payload
          const parseResult = AlertPayloadSchema.safeParse(request.body);
          if (!parseResult.success) {
            return reply
              .code(400)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  400,
                  "Bad Request",
                  `Invalid alert payload: ${parseResult.error.message}`
                )
              );
          }
    
          const payload: AlertPayload = parseResult.data;
    
          // 3. Skip info-level alerts (log only)
          if (payload.severity === "info") {
            fastify.log.info(
              { alertName: payload.alertName, source: payload.source },
              "Info-level alert received — no action taken"
            );
            return reply.code(200).send({ sessionId: "" });
          }
    
          // 4. Check circuit breaker
          const circuitCheck = checkCircuitBreaker();
          if (!circuitCheck.allowed) {
            fastify.log.warn(
              { alertName: payload.alertName, reason: circuitCheck.reason },
              "Remediation circuit breaker is open"
            );
            return reply
              .code(503)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  503,
                  "Service Unavailable",
                  circuitCheck.reason ?? "Circuit breaker open"
                )
              );
          }
    
          // 5. Build investigation task
          const taskDescription =
            `[PRODUCTION ALERT — ${payload.severity.toUpperCase()}] ${payload.alertName}\n\n` +
            `Alert summary: ${payload.summary}\n\n` +
            `Source: ${payload.source}\n` +
            (payload.generatorURL ? `Dashboard: ${payload.generatorURL}\n` : "") +
            (payload.labels ? `Labels: ${JSON.stringify(payload.labels)}\n` : "") +
            `\nInvestigate the production issue described above. ` +
            `Check recent deployments (git log --oneline -10), error logs, and the affected code paths. ` +
            `If the root cause is identifiable from the codebase, create a fix PR. ` +
            `If it requires infrastructure or environment changes outside the codebase, ` +
            `create a draft PR documenting the investigation findings and recommended action.`;
    
          fastify.log.info(
            { alertName: payload.alertName, severity: payload.severity, source: payload.source },
            "Creating remediation session"
          );
    
          const result = await triggerSession({
            taskDescription,
            baseBranch: "main",
            onSettled: recordRemediationOutcome,
          });
    
          if (!result.accepted) {
            return reply
              .code(503)
              .send(
                createProblemDetails(
                  503,
                  "Service Unavailable",
                  "Maximum concurrent sessions reached. Try again later."
                )
              );
          }
    
          return { sessionId: result.session!.id };
        }
      );
    };
